# Electricity

Supplied by Kestrel Energy since 19 September 2026 on a fixed 24-month tariff. The
previous supplier was Brightvale Power, who raised the unit rate twice in one year,
which is what prompted the switch.

## Account

- Account number: KE-8842071
- MPAN: 1900012345678
- Meter serial: E12N4471088
- Direct debit: 118.00 on the 4th

## Tariff

- Unit rate 21.94p per kWh, standing charge 41.12p per day
- Fixed until 19 September 2028, exit fee 75.00 per fuel
- Previous Brightvale Power rate was 22.72p per kWh from 6 August 2026
